text: Implemented and documented the deliberate equal-dimensional AffineIso/Grid scope (D2-in-D2, D3-in-D3; future embeddings must be separate types). Hardened fromOriginSpacingDirection with orthonormal direction checks including reflections, separated anisotropic spacing, added full inverse-residual and linear-basis infinity-condition diagnostics with configurable limits, and rejected near-singular/noncanonical cases. Replaced public generic point/vector construction with singleton-owner inference plus checked alignOwners transport. Added LatticeIndex, grid-owned bounded GridIndex, and an Index migration alias. Verified 200 non-locus tests across JVM/Scala.js: affine identity/inverse/associativity properties, reflection/anisotropy/near-singular/residual cases, every finite boundary and Int overflow endpoints, cross-grid compile rejection, singleton-owner compile courts, D2-in-D3 scope rejection/D3 singleton acceptance, canonical geometry checksum, consumers, NIfTI, and laws. Optimized core/NIfTI Scala.js links and git diff --check pass. Dirty image4s-locus remains untouched/excluded.
